text: Hebr. Obadiahu. , Hebr. ouer his house.
Hebr. that we cut not off our selues from the beasts.
Or, answere. , Or, heard. , Or, leaped vp & downe at the altar.
Heb. with a great voice , Or, he meditateth. , Heb. hath a pursuit.
Hebr. powred out blood vpon them.
Or, a sound of a noise of raine.
Heb. till thou come to Iezreel.
